title: ProAppStore Application Standard — audit report and finding
description: The AI audit contract (audit-model.md#findings). A report lists one finding per clause evaluated. A `fail` (and a `manual-review` worth raising) becomes one GitHub issue whose title names the defect. Deduplication key formula: `<app_id>:<clause_id>:<primary evidence path>` where the primary evidence path is `evidence[0].path` — so a re-run never opens a second issue for the same defect.

standard_version.description: The standard version audited against (standard.json → standard.version)

app_id.description: The app id / repository name / subdomain

commit_sha.description: The commit the evidence was read from

audited_at.description: ISO date. Keep the report deterministic: same commit + same standard version ⇒ same findings and keys

deployment_evidence.description: The bundle PAS-OPS-020 requires; optional for read-only audits

path.description: Repository path (configuration/source/process/documentation) or a URL (runtime). The first item's path is the primary evidence path used in dedupe_key

excerpt.description: A short quote of the evidence — never a secret or personal data

observation.description: What was observed (runtime) or why this file proves the point

clause_url.description: Must equal the clause's url in standard.json

title.description: Names the DEFECT, in the app's terms — e.g. 'Session token stored in localStorage' — never just the clause ID. Also the GitHub issue title

severity.description: The clause's default unless lowered with a stated reason; never raised without human validation

severity_reason.description: Required when severity differs from the clause default

reason.description: Why the clause applies, or the evidence that its condition is not met (a not-applicable is a result, not a skip)

evidence.description: At least one item for fail; for pass/not-applicable, what was inspected

impact.description: Required for fail: what the failure allows or breaks, in the app's own terms

remediation.description: Required for fail: one bounded change — one clause, one app, one PR

acceptance_tests.description: Required for fail: how the fix is proven, from the clause's Tests

human_validation.description: required when verification is human, when confidence is below high, or when the remediation would change architecture
